evals.prompt: I run a small skincare brand, we sell on our Shopify site and on Amazon, about 2.5 lakh a month on Meta ads. I want to set up a proper P&L that I can show investors. Can you help me build one? Start from April 2025.
evals.expected_output: Short interview (category inferred as BPC, channels website + amazon, unit INR lakh, ship-fee decision), a config JSON, a generated .xlsx with Start Here, Consolidated P&L, Website, Amazon, Cash & Working Capital, Checks, Definitions tabs, verify run with errors: 0, and a 5-6 sentence walkthrough.

evals.prompt: We're a women's apparel brand on our own website and Myntra. Where do exchanges go in the P&L? Myntra shows them as returns but we ship a replacement, and our logistics bill is huge. Also are Myntra's commission and the 'shipping fee' they deduct a revenue deduction or a cost?
evals.expected_output: Answers from the canonical waterfall: exchanges as revenue deduction at full value (gross) by default with the net alternative and the double-counted logistics warning; Myntra commission and platform shipping fee as CM1 costs because Myntra bills them and the brand invoices the shopper; states what moves (GM% vs CM1%) and that EBITDA is unchanged. No workbook generated unless asked.

evals.prompt: Here's our MIS from the skill, we filled in April to July. We also just started selling on Blinkit in July. Can you add Blinkit and tell me if anything looks off in the numbers so far?
evals.expected_output: Reads Start Here to rebuild config if needed, adds a qcom channel, asks the qcom promo placement question with default, regenerates with --preserve, verifies, then runs check_mis.py on the filled file and gives a short review using archetype bands.
